title: Weak or Expired TLS Configuration
summary: The server supports deprecated protocols/ciphers or presents an expired/invalid certificate, weakening transport security.
detection: Enumerate supported protocol versions and ciphers; check certificate validity window, hostname match and chain. Flag SSLv3/TLS1.0/TLS1.1 and expired certs.
remediation: Disable SSLv2/SSLv3 and TLS 1.0/1.1; require TLS 1.2+ (prefer 1.3). Use strong ciphers, enable HSTS, and automate certificate renewal.
